subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should configured-but-unresolved local gateway credentials replace the existing reachability probe with an unconditional failure across all status commands?
rationale: The implementation is intentional and the local diagnostics are proven, but choosing whether existing operator probes may stop attempting transport is a compatibility and product-policy decision that source review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Preserve the current probe default
options.body: Keep probing by default and report the unresolved credential as a warning or diagnostic, reserving strict pre-probe failure for an explicitly approved path.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast deliberately
options.body: Approve the new default only with clear upgrade documentation and proof that fresh and upgraded required-auth installations receive the intended operator-facing recovery path.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current probe default
recommendation.body: Keep probing by default and report the unresolved credential as a warning or diagnostic, reserving strict pre-probe failure for an explicitly approved path.

likelyOwner.reason: Most direct decision-routing candidate from the PR's explicit gateway/auth review mentions.
